text: At our Poly Packaging Factory, we take pride in offering a wide range of products that cater to various sectors and industries.   With our diverse product portfolio, we can meet the unique packaging needs of different businesses and sectors.    Here are some of the products we offer and the sectors they serve:

images.src: ./Sri Lanka's Plastic Manufacturing Expert - DKW Plastics_files/ziplocks-c7cf2dd5.webp.png

text: Discover versatile storage solutions with our unique Resealable Ziplock Bags, tailored to your needs. These Ziplocks are ideal for robust needs in jewelry, spare-parts, manufacturing, office organization, medical storage, and home use. Plain Ziplock Bags Ziplock Bags with Customized Print Ziplock Bags with Patch Handles Personalize your Ziplocks with our customizable features like patch handles and printed artwork to create a perfect fit for your requirements.

images.src: ./Sri Lanka's Plastic Manufacturing Expert - DKW Plastics_files/food-2fb38c05.webp.png

text: We take pride in delivering government-certified food-grade packaging options, which strictly adhere to rigorous quality and safety standards. Our comprehensive range is tailored to diverse food products, consisting of films, inner bulk bags, and more. To name a few: Tea, Flour, Sugar, Mixture Bags Bakery Items Bulk Dry Food Items These solutions exceed industry requirements, enabling an extended shelf life. safeguarding freshness, providing protection for food items during prolonged storage and transportation.

images.src: ./Sri Lanka's Plastic Manufacturing Expert - DKW Plastics_files/textile-d979efb0.webp.png

text: Our retail textile bags are designed to be both stylish and functional, making them the perfect choice for businesses looking to make a positive impression. Reinforce (Patch) Handle Carrier Bags Loop Handle Kidney Cut Bags Available in various sizes, materials, and customization options, we can tailor our bags to meet your specific requirements.

images.src: ./Sri Lanka's Plastic Manufacturing Expert - DKW Plastics_files/410_farm-6475205f.webp.png

text: Our agricultural packaging solutions are designed to withstand the demands of the industry. Nursery Bag (with or without Perforation) 3 Layer Film Film Supply for Lamination 3 Layer Film Supply for Rain Guards We offer durable and protective packaging for rubber estates, tea plantations, and other crops, ensuring that your products are safely transported and stored.

images.src: ./Sri Lanka's Plastic Manufacturing Expert - DKW Plastics_files/garment-ee30ddca.webp.png

text: When it comes to garment packaging, including hanger bags, we specialize in providing solutions that merge practicality with elegance. Our range of garment packaging options is meticulously designed to ensure the safe and stylish presentation of your clothing. Hanger Bags Garment Covers Envelope Bags Whether it’s hanger bags, garment covers, or customized packaging, we understand the importance of making your clothing look its best. Our solutions not only protect your garments but also elevate their visual appeal, making them ready to shine in any retail or storage setting.

images.src: ./Sri Lanka's Plastic Manufacturing Expert - DKW Plastics_files/poly-c60b2b9b.webp.png

text: Introducing our 6 Multi-Color Polythene Tube/Reel Form packaging, available in a variety of materials including HDPE, PP, LDPE, and LLDPE. These versatile packaging solutions offer a burst of vibrant colors, adding visual appeal to your products. Whether you need to showcase your items, organize materials, or create eye-catching displays, our Multi- Color Polythene Tube/Reel Form packaging does it all with flair. Crafted with precision and quality, these packaging options provide both style and functionality, making them an ideal choice for a wide range of applications.

images.src: ./Sri Lanka's Plastic Manufacturing Expert - DKW Plastics_files/guss-cccdba24.webp.png

text: Gusseted Bags, available in both Bottom Seal Side Gusset and Side Seal Bottom Gusset designs, offer exceptional versatility for various packaging needs. Their expandable side gussets enable you to accommodate bulkier or irregularly shaped items with ease, making them perfect for packaging textiles, clothing, food items, or promotional materials. Whether you need to store, display, or transport goods, our Gusseted Bags provide a reliable and adaptable solution to meet your requirements.

images.src: ./Sri Lanka's Plastic Manufacturing Expert - DKW Plastics_files/house-542adf51.webp.png

text: Explore our household essentials, featuring robust Garbage Bags and customized, styled Table Cloths. Our Garbage Bags have been tested for durability to minimize leaks and tears, while our Table Cloths bring style and protection to your dining space. Elevate your home with these functional and fashionable solutions.

At our Poly Packaging Factory, we offer a comprehensive range of services to complement our high-quality packaging products.
With our expertise, advanced technology, and commitment to customer satisfaction, we strive to provide exceptional value to our clients.
Here are some of the services we provide:

Recycling Scheme   We will buy eligible plastics products for recycling. Please reach out to obtain further details on what we can recycle. On-time Delivery   We take pride in our 98% on-time delivery rate, showcasing our commitment to meeting deadlines and satisfying our clients. Scalable Production   Our state-of-the-art facility has a production capacity of 500 tons per month, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality products. < >
